title: Durable authority and historical replay
summary: TimeAuthorityLedger provides a single-writer append-only command journal for institutional definitions, phrase bindings and date exceptions, with revisions and historical resolveAt replay. The chained checksum detects accidental inconsistencies and supports revision witnesses; it is neither a cryptographic signature nor protected against malicious rewriting.
invariants: Reject invalid mutation before append and stale/wrong-head revisions.
Historical authority revision and TZif rule edition are independently pinned: one does not substitute for the other.
Single-writer means no guaranteed cross-process locks, fsync, replication, authenticated timestamps or tamper-proof history.

provenance.claim: Verified against locally inspected v0.9 package source.
